opening.argument: The video is grounded in market commentary: it frames ADA's performance within broader altcoin conditions, stating, "Not an ADA bear market but an altcoin bear market," and compares cryptocurrency assets and their market-cycle outcomes. The visible ADA price chart and spreadsheet of cryptocurrency market data reinforce that analytical focus. Its discussion of a future all-time high is expressly conditional: "just because you did not set an all-time high in this last cycle, doesn't mean you can't do it". The separate references to leveraged-trading platforms and bonuses do not connect those promotions to the ADA analysis or show deceptive conduct. Nor does the discussion require viewers to provide money, credentials, or other participation.
